name: ppe-yolov8s
description: YOLOv8s PPE detector, 6 classes, exported to ONNX at 320 px with dynamic int8 weights. The same file the in-browser demo on zulfaqarhafez.com runs.

input.name: images
input.layout: NCHW, RGB, 0 to 1, letterboxed with grey 114

output.name: output0
output.layout: rows 0-3 cx, cy, w, h in letterboxed pixels; rows 4-9 class scores; no objectness, no NMS in the graph

io.decode: per-class NMS at IoU 0.7, default score threshold 0.25 (as on the site)

lineage.export: Ultralytics ONNX export, opset 12, imgsz 320, no NMS, then onnxruntime quantize_dynamic (QUInt8) from the fp32 320 export
lineage.trained_by: course project teammates (university course AAI3001); Zulfaqar Hafez was a team member

licence.model: AGPL-3.0 (Ultralytics YOLOv8; check the Ultralytics licence terms before reuse)
licence.dataset: CC BY 4.0, Personal Protective Equipment v5, Roboflow Universe workspace maxis, https://universe.roboflow.com/maxis/personal-protective-equipment-dtt2i-9qixs

metrics.note: Copied from the course repository's eval file; not re-measured by this service.
